papers.title: Automatic keyphrase extraction and annotation: modern theoretical approaches and practical solutions for text and speech
papers.translated_title: 自动关键词提取与标注：面向文本和语音的现代理论方法与实践解决方案
papers.author: Daria Guseva
papers.summary: The exponential growth of textual and audiovisual information has made the task of automatic keyphrase extraction (KE) increasingly significant. This article provides a comprehensive analysis of contemporary theoretical approaches and practical solutions for KE across both text and speech modalities. The primary contribution of this work is its systematic synthesis of these often-disparate research strands into a unified analytical framework, highlighting the evolution of the field from statistical methods towards large language models (LLMs) and end-to-end speech processing. We examine the stages of KE, the characteristics of keyphrases in written and spoken language, and terminological nuances. Various methods for automatic KE are discussed and analyzed in detail: statistical, hybrid, machine learning-based, and structural. The review dedicates substantial attention to emerging paradigms, including keyphrase generation using LLMs, and provides a detailed overview of methodologies and challenges in automatic corpus annotation. Furthermore, we specifically analyze current directions and inherent difficulties in KE for spoken language, comparing transcript based and end-to-end acoustic approaches. This synthesis leads us to conclude that the field is moving towards a more integrated, context-aware paradigm. Future progress will depend on addressing key challenges such as data scarcity for low-resource languages, effective multimodal fusion, and the nuanced evaluation of generative KE systems.
papers.translated_summary: 文本和视听信息的指数级增长使得自动关键词提取（KE）任务日益重要。本文对文本和语音两种模态下关键词提取的当代理论方法与实践解决方案进行了全面分析。本工作的主要贡献在于将这些往往彼此分离的研究脉络系统地综合为一个统一的分析框架，凸显了该领域从统计方法向大语言模型（LLMs）和端到端语音处理的演进。我们考察了关键词提取的各阶段、书面语与口语中关键词的特征以及术语上的细微差异。本文详细讨论和分析了多种自动关键词提取方法：统计方法、混合方法、基于机器学习的方法以及结构方法。本综述重点关注新兴范式，包括利用大语言模型进行关键词生成，并详细概述了自动语料标注的方法论与挑战。此外，我们专门分析了口语关键词提取的当前方向与内在困难，比较了基于转录文本的方法与端到端声学方法。这一综合分析使我们得出结论：该领域正朝着更加集成化、上下文感知的范式发展。未来的进展将取决于能否解决诸如低资源语言的数据稀缺、有效的多模态融合以及对生成式关键词提取系统的细致评估等关键挑战。

papers.title: Deformable Contact-Aware 3D Object Placement
papers.translated_title: 可变形接触感知的三维物体放置
papers.author: Songhe Wang
papers.summary: Current language-guided 3D object placement typically predicts a rigid 6-DoF pose, ignoring the physical reality that indoor placements are dictated by contact. Consequently, predicted poses often float, interpenetrate supports, or fail to deform soft surfaces. We propose Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework that reframes placement as a drop-to-equilibrium process. Rather than predicting a static pose, DCAP constructs a semantic release state that specifies the drop location, object scale, and deformable components, allowing a coupled rigid-deformable simulator to settle the object under gravity and friction. This explicitly separates semantic intent from physical realization. Evaluated on a benchmark of 2,063 prompt-asset-scene cases, DCAP significantly outperforms static baselines. On standard placements, it improves VLM Physics & Naturalness by 21.2 points and human preference by 26.5 points over the strongest raw rigid baseline, while reducing mean penetration depth by 72.3%. Compared to simulated rollout baselines, DCAP reduces residual speed by 72.1%. Ultimately, our results prove that physically accurate 3D placement requires modeling semantic intent and physical realization as strictly separate processes.
papers.translated_summary: 当前的语言引导三维物体放置通常预测一个刚性的六自由度位姿，忽略了室内放置由接触决定的物理现实。因此，预测的位姿常常悬浮、穿透支撑物或无法使软表面变形。我们提出可变形接触感知放置（DCAP），一个将放置重新定义为下落至平衡过程的框架。DCAP不预测静态位姿，而是构建一个语义释放状态，指定下落位置、物体尺度和可变形部件，使耦合的刚体-可变形模拟器能够在重力和摩擦力作用下使物体稳定。这明确地将语义意图与物理实现分离。在包含2,063个提示-资产-场景案例的基准上评估，DCAP显著优于静态基线。在标准放置上，相比最强的原始刚性基线，它将VLM物理与自然度提高了21.2分，人类偏好提高了26.5分，同时将平均穿透深度降低了72.3%。与模拟推演基线相比，DCAP将残余速度降低了72.1%。最终，我们的结果证明，物理准确的三维放置要求将语义意图和物理实现建模为严格分离的过程。

papers.title: When GeoFMs Meet VHR: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Very High Resolution Earth Observation Imagery
papers.translated_title: 当地理基础模型遇上甚高分辨率：在甚高分辨率对地观测影像上评测基础模型
papers.author: Kshitij Raj Sharma
papers.summary: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.
papers.translated_summary: 地理空间基础模型是遥感任务中广泛采用的起点。大多数模型在10米或更粗地面采样距离（GSD）的Sentinel-1/2和Landsat影像上进行预训练。然而，许多应用依赖于甚高分辨率（VHR）影像，其中单体建筑、道路和设施均可分辨。我们研究了哪些预训练范式能够良好迁移到这一尺度。我们提出VHR-Bench，一个包含十个数据集的基准套件，GSD为1.5米或更精细，涵盖五个任务族、八个应用领域以及卫星和航空两种平台。我们评估了三个预训练层级中的十二个编码器，冻结骨干网络，并在两种训练数据比例下进行测试。我们发现，在大规模自然图像集合上的预训练和针对VHR的预训练都能有效迁移到VHR任务，且各具互补优势。在标签稀缺时SkySense领先；在完整标签比例下，经网络预训练的DINOv3 ViT-L略占优势，两者在该条件下较为接近。仅在Sentinel尺度影像上预训练的编码器在RGB输入下迁移效果最差。基于这些互补结果，我们在102万块留出的VHR瓦片上继续对DINOv3 ViT-L进行自监督预训练，并在不改变下游协议的情况下评估所得编码器。在标签稀缺时，继续训练的模型相较已发布骨干网络有明显提升，在完整标签比例下有适度提升，且不增加推理参数或计算量。这些发现支持一种“先泛化、后特化”的策略：已经强大且广泛的自然图像预训练可以通过短暂的VHR继续训练阶段得到进一步改进，同时保留其通用视觉特征。

papers.title: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
papers.translated_title: 面向聚合物性质预测的基于几何片段化的多尺度分子表示学习
papers.author: Makoto Takamoto
papers.summary: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. To address these limitations, we formulate molecular fragmentation as a radius-constrained optimization problem inspired by the k-center formulation, where the number of clusters is not fixed a priori but emerges from the specified radius, and propose a geometry-based fragmentation method that partitions arbitrary molecular or material structures using largely geometric information, without relying on predefined chemical fragmentation rules. The method provides flexible control over fragment size, enabling the construction of multiscale fragment representations for scale-adaptive modeling. Building on this framework, we develop a geometric fragment-based attention mechanism that integrates multiscale structural information and incorporate it into a multimodal machine learning model combining p-SMILES representations with three-dimensional (3D) conformational information. Experiments on a benchmark polymer dataset show that incorporating 3D conformational information improves prediction accuracy for several properties over models based exclusively on p-SMILES representations. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses further provide insights into the physical relevance of the learned representations.
papers.translated_summary: 众所周知，分子子结构对化学和物理性质的贡献并不均等，特定基序或侧链往往发挥主导作用。因此，基于片段的表示已成为引入具有化学意义的归纳偏置的有效策略，分子指纹和基于片段的注意力机制即为典型代表。然而，许多现有的基于碎片化的机器学习方法依赖预定义的化学规则，对于此前未见或化学上不熟悉的结构可能产生次优的碎片化结果，且往往忽视多尺度分子表示的重要性。为解决这些局限，我们受k中心公式启发，将分子碎片化建模为半径约束优化问题，其中簇的数量并非先验固定，而是由指定半径决定，并提出一种基于几何的碎片化方法，主要利用几何信息对任意分子或材料结构进行划分，而不依赖预定义的化学碎片化规则。该方法可灵活控制片段大小，从而构建多尺度片段表示以支持尺度自适应建模。在此框架基础上，我们开发了一种基于几何片段的注意力机制，整合多尺度结构信息，并将其融入结合p-SMILES表示与三维（3D）构象信息的多模态机器学习模型。在基准聚合物数据集上的实验表明，与仅基于p-SMILES表示的模型相比，引入3D构象信息可提高若干性质的预测精度。可解释人工智能分析进一步揭示了所学表示的物理相关性。

papers.title: SEER: A Scalable Event-Driven Runtime for Parallel Execution of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environments
papers.translated_title: SEER：一种用于多智能体强化学习环境并行执行的可扩展事件驱动运行时
papers.author: Jiming Su
papers.summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is increasingly used in systems where many entities interact in a shared environment. In these workloads, policy inference can be batched on GPUs, but the CPU-side environment path still updates entity states, resolves local interactions, and builds observations inside each $\mathrm{env.step}$. This path can dominate latency in interaction-intensive workloads after policy batching. Existing vectorized environment interfaces and general event-driven runtimes do not directly address the fine-grained cross-entity work inside one bounded MARL step while preserving the step-level semantics expected by learning systems. We present SEER (Scalable Event-Driven Environment Runtime), a runtime for MARL environment execution under an explicit event-locality contract. SEER models each environment step as a bounded stream of timestamped events. If direct state updates are entity-local and cross-entity effects are represented as ordered future events, SEER can run independent events in parallel while preserving serial-equivalent boundary outputs. To make this contract practical, SEER uses a CAS-based dual-layer event queue: local event queues preserve per-entity causal order, while a parallel executive list exposes ready work to global worker threads. SEER further uses STPA, a preflight-guided thread-pool selection mechanism that combines short runtime traces with static workload and hardware features. We evaluate SEER on two parameterized MARL workloads: compute-intensive UAV swarm control (Aircraft) and communication-intensive wireless management (PCS). On Aircraft, SEER reduces inference latency by 16.2\% over the baseline. On PCS, SEER reduces environment-execution latency by 46.9\%, 19.5\%, and 64.9\% over ROSS-T, NBSE, and ROOT-Sim, respectively.
papers.translated_summary: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）正日益应用于众多实体在共享环境中交互的系统。在这类工作负载中，策略推理可以在 GPU 上批处理，但 CPU 侧的环境路径仍然要在每个 $\mathrm{env.step}$ 内更新实体状态、解析局部交互并构建观测。在策略批处理之后，这条路径可能主导交互密集型工作负载的延迟。现有的向量化环境接口和通用事件驱动运行时无法直接处理单个有界 MARL 步骤内细粒度的跨实体工作，同时保持学习系统所期望的步骤级语义。我们提出 SEER（可扩展事件驱动环境运行时），一种在显式事件局部性契约下执行 MARL 环境的运行时。SEER 将每个环境步骤建模为有界的时间戳事件流。如果直接状态更新是实体局部的，且跨实体效应被表示为有序的未来事件，SEER 就能并行运行独立事件，同时保持与串行等价的边界输出。为使该契约实用化，SEER 采用基于 CAS 的双层事件队列：本地事件队列保持每个实体的因果顺序，而并行执行列表将就绪工作暴露给全局工作线程。SEER 进一步采用 STPA，一种预检引导的线程池选择机制，将短期运行时轨迹与静态工作负载和硬件特征相结合。我们在两个参数化 MARL 工作负载上评估 SEER：计算密集型的无人机集群控制（Aircraft）和通信密集型的无线管理（PCS）。在 Aircraft 上，SEER 相比基线将推理延迟降低 16.2\%。在 PCS 上，SEER 相比 ROSS-T、NBSE 和 ROOT-Sim 分别将环境执行延迟降低 46.9\%、19.5\% 和 64.9\%。

papers.title: Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection
papers.translated_title: 恢复被丢弃的高分辨率特征用于基于Transformer的小目标检测
papers.author: Zehao Wang
papers.summary: Tiny object detection remains challenging because tiny instances occupy only a few pixels, and their fine-grained details are easily lost during feature downsampling. Although the highest-resolution feature preserves rich local details for tiny objects, DETR-like detectors often discard it due to its large computational cost, while directly reintroducing this feature also brings dense background noise. To address this problem, we propose ReDHF, a novel framework that Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature for tiny object detection. ReDHF has three cooperative components. Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion (CSDF) first constructs a semantically enhanced highest-resolution feature and injects its fine-grained details into the shallow feature under a moderate cost. Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) then guides the enhanced feature to learn more reliable classification and localization priors by applying geometry-adaptive auxiliary supervision. Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI) further enables decoder queries to access both low-level details and high-level semantic information, allowing them to aggregate richer cues for tiny objects. Extensive experiments show that ReDHF consistently improves multiple baselines across different DETR variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the evaluated benchmarks. The best ReDHF variants surpass their baselines by +1.4 AP on AI-TOD-v2, +1.6 AP on VisDrone, and +1.5 AP on SODA-D, with especially notable gains on tiny and small objects.
papers.translated_summary: 微小目标检测仍然具有挑战性，因为微小实例仅占据几个像素，其细粒度细节在特征下采样过程中容易丢失。尽管最高分辨率特征保留了微小目标的丰富局部细节，但类DETR检测器常因其巨大的计算开销而将其丢弃，而直接重新引入该特征也会带来密集的背景噪声。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ReDHF，一种新颖的框架，旨在复活被丢弃的高分辨率特征以用于微小目标检测。ReDHF包含三个协同组件。跨尺度可变形融合（CSDF）首先构建语义增强的最高分辨率特征，并以适中的代价将其细粒度细节注入浅层特征。椭圆引导浅层监督（EGSS）随后通过应用几何自适应辅助监督，引导增强特征学习更可靠的分类与定位先验。全尺度查询交互（FSQI）进一步使解码器查询能够同时访问低层细节和高层语义信息，从而为微小目标聚合更丰富的线索。大量实验表明，ReDHF在不同DETR变体上持续改进多个基线，并在所评估的基准上达到最先进性能。最佳的ReDHF变体在AI-TOD-v2上超越其基线+1.4 AP，在VisDrone上+1.6 AP，在SODA-D上+1.5 AP，在微小和小型目标上增益尤为显著。

papers.title: Compression Through a Context Lens: Evaluating Adaptation, Quantization, and Distillation in Arabic Legal LLMs
papers.translated_title: 通过语境视角看压缩：评估阿拉伯语法律大语言模型中的适配、量化与蒸馏
papers.author: Md. Rafiul Biswas
papers.summary: Model compression can facilitate the deployment of large language models in resource-constrained legal settings, but its effects on domain-specific performance may depend on the evaluation protocol. We investigate this issue using ArabLegalEval, a Saudi Arabic legal benchmark, under both with-context and no-context evaluation. The former provides supporting legal passages, while the latter assesses performance without external context. Removing the context produces accuracy gaps of up to 27 percentage points for the base model. We examine three stages: domain adaptation, quantization, and knowledge distillation across FANAR-9B, JAIS-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B. Four-bit quantization reduces model memory by 64-71%, with changes in no-context MCQ accuracy ranging from -3.2 to +1.6 percentage points. Distillation produces more variable results, with accuracy generally declining as student size decreases. A Qwen2.5-7B student distilled from FANAR achieves 76.6% no-context accuracy, compared with 77.2% for its teacher. Our findings suggest that no-context evaluation provides a useful complement to context-supported testing when assessing the effects of adaptation and compression on Arabic legal language models.
papers.translated_summary: 模型压缩有助于在资源受限的法律环境中部署大语言模型，但其对领域特定性能的影响可能取决于评估协议。我们使用沙特阿拉伯语法律基准 ArabLegalEval，在有上下文和无上下文两种评估方式下研究这一问题。前者提供支持性法律段落，后者则在无外部上下文的情况下评估性能。移除上下文会使基础模型的准确率差距最高达到27个百分点。我们考察了领域适应、量化和知识蒸馏三个阶段，涵盖 FANAR-9B、JAIS-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B。四比特量化使模型内存减少64-71%，无上下文选择题准确率的变化范围为-3.2至+1.6个百分点。蒸馏产生的结果更为多变，准确率通常随学生模型规模减小而下降。由 FANAR 蒸馏得到的 Qwen2.5-7B 学生模型达到76.6%的无上下文准确率，而其教师模型为77.2%。我们的研究结果表明，在评估适应和压缩对阿拉伯语法律语言模型的影响时，无上下文评估为有上下文支持的测试提供了有用的补充。

papers.title: Technohybridism: Recursive Semantic Normalization in AI-Mediated Societies
papers.translated_title: 技术混合主义：人工智能中介社会中的递归语义规范化
papers.author: Charalampos M. Liapis
papers.summary: Language-generating AI systems are no longer only objects of linguistic interaction: their outputs increasingly re-enter the communicative and institutional practices from which their training material was drawn. Drawing on social theory, social epistemology, and the philosophy of language, this article develops a sociotechnical account of that re-entry. We introduce recursive semantic normalization: the process through which machine-generated formulations, once recurrently taken up, evaluated, reused, and institutionally retained, participate in the reproduction and transformation of semantic regularities. Under the heading of technohybridism, we argue that the relevant unit of analysis is the hybrid semantic system, a recursively coupled configuration of human practices, computational generation, and institutional uptake. First, we distinguish the concept from neighbouring accounts, including model collapse, looping effects, machine habitus, machine culture, and the epistemology of AI testimony. Second, we develop an analytical model that separates generation, selection, uptake, and persistence and distinguishes machine-attributable change from change that would have occurred anyway. Third, we analyse uptake as routinized, institutionally diffused, and socially stratified practice and state conditions under which machine-derived regularities become norms. Fourth, we identify social-epistemic consequences: the laundering of provenance that weakens epistemic vigilance, the erosion of the cognitive diversity on which collective inquiry depends, and the narrowing of shared hermeneutical resources. An evidential ladder for empirical research follows. The account attributes no normative authority to machine outputs; what changes is the field within which human and institutional uptake operates.
papers.translated_summary: 语言生成式人工智能系统不再仅仅是语言互动的对象：其输出正日益重新进入其训练材料所源自的沟通与制度实践。本文借鉴社会理论、社会认识论和语言哲学，对这种重新进入展开社会技术性阐释。我们提出递归语义规范化这一概念：即机器生成的表述一经反复被采纳、评估、复用并在制度中留存，便参与到语义规律性的再生产与转变之中。在技术混合主义这一标题下，我们主张相关的分析单元是混合语义系统，即人类实践、计算生成与制度采纳三者之间递归耦合的配置。首先，我们将这一概念与相近的论述区分开来，包括模型崩溃、循环效应、机器惯习、机器文化以及人工智能证言的认识论。其次，我们构建一个分析模型，将生成、选择、采纳与持续留存区分开来，并将可归因于机器的变化与无论如何都会发生的变化区分开来。第三，我们将采纳分析为常规化、制度性扩散且社会分层化的实践，并阐明机器衍生的规律性在何种条件下成为规范。第四，我们识别出社会认识论层面的后果：来源洗白削弱了认识论警觉，集体探究所依赖的认知多样性遭到侵蚀，共享的解释学资源趋于窄化。随后提出一条面向实证研究的证据阶梯。该阐释不赋予机器输出任何规范性权威；发生变化的是人类与制度采纳所运作的场域。

papers.title: How Far Can Lightweight LLMs Go in Intent-to-SLO Translation?
papers.translated_title: 轻量级大语言模型在意图到SLO转换中能走多远？
papers.author: Sabbir Ahmed
papers.summary: Intent-based networking (IBN) promises QoS provisioning in which the network derives the configuration from operator-stated goals. Its first step, translating a natural-language intent into enforceable service-level objectives (SLOs) grounded in a live snapshot of the network state, increasingly relies on large language models (LLMs). These large models add cost and energy to the management loop and typically require multi-GPU, cloud-hosted infrastructure. Can lightweight open LLMs take over this step dependably? We answer this question with a five-dimensional evaluation of ten LLMs with <10B parameters from five families, under four prompting setups, on 716 placement intents. We evaluate translation performance, intent validation, hallucination, energy impact, and robustness to diverse phrasing. The best configurations translate intents with a strict F1 of 0.943 and reject up to 191 of 195 invalid intents. With few-shot reasoning, the strongest models hallucinate unsupported QoS requirements in only about one response in a hundred, whereas the zero-shot setup struggles. A translated intent costs 0.044-0.148 Wh of GPU energy without reasoning, and added energy cost for reasoning pays off for the weaker models. Furthermore, we show that realistic rephrasing lowers the rejection of invalid intents in 15 of 16 configurations for the best-performing models, leaving robust intent validation as a key open challenge for reliable IBN. Our code and data are available: https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo.
papers.translated_summary: 基于意图的网络（IBN）承诺提供服务质量（QoS）保障，其中网络从操作员陈述的目标中推导出配置。其第一步是将自然语言意图转换为可执行的服務水平目标（SLO），并基于网络状态的实时快照进行落地，这一步骤日益依赖大语言模型（LLM）。这些大模型为管理回路增加了成本和能耗，并且通常需要多GPU、云托管的基础设施。轻量级开源LLM能否可靠地接管这一步骤？我们通过对来自五个系列的十个参数小于10B的LLM，在四种提示设置下，针对716个放置意图进行五维评估来回答这个问题。我们评估翻译性能、意图验证、幻觉、能耗影响以及对多样化表述的鲁棒性。最佳配置以0.943的严格F1翻译意图，并在195个无效意图中最多拒绝191个。在少样本推理下，最强的模型仅在约百分之一的响应中幻觉出不受支持的QoS需求，而零样本设置则表现不佳。在没有推理的情况下，翻译一个意图消耗0.044-0.148 Wh的GPU能量，而为推理增加的能耗成本对较弱的模型是值得的。此外，我们表明，对于表现最佳的模型，现实的重新表述在16种配置中的15种降低了无效意图的拒绝率，使得鲁棒的意图验证成为可靠IBN的关键开放挑战。我们的代码和数据可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/ggck43/intent2slo。

papers.title: QRAE: Query-Relevant Attention Entropy for Context Compression in DeepSearch Agents
papers.translated_title: QRAE：面向深度搜索智能体上下文压缩的查询相关注意力熵
papers.author: Yingjie Tan
papers.summary: DeepSearch LLM agents repeatedly search and carry retrieved sources into subsequent reasoning steps. This expanding context increases token consumption and latency, although many results do not contribute to later reasoning. We propose Query-Relevant Attention Entropy (QRAE), an online context compression method that uses sparse evidence-assessment heads to decide which intact retrieved chunks should persist across reasoning steps. It scores bounded candidate batches through paired prefills: a query-free control suppresses shared attention responses, while normalized entropy measures the breadth of the positive response within each chunk. High-scoring chunks enter a persistent evidence whitelist and are included in the reasoning context. Uncertain chunks remain outside the reasoning context but are retained in a candidate cache, where they can be retrieved for later reevaluation. QRAE requires neither an additional generative compression pass nor modification of the attention operator. Across multiple DeepSearch benchmarks and reasoning models, QRAE improves task success by an average of 2.35 percentage points and reduces end-to-end latency and reported token usage by an average of 30% and 45%, respectively. These benefits generalize to a model with nearly 100B parameters.
papers.translated_summary: DeepSearch LLM智能体会反复搜索，并将检索到的来源带入后续推理步骤。这种不断扩展的上下文会增加token消耗和延迟，尽管许多结果对后续推理并无贡献。我们提出Query-Relevant Attention Entropy（QRAE），一种在线上下文压缩方法，利用稀疏证据评估头来决定哪些完整检索块应在推理步骤间持续保留。它通过成对预填充对有界候选批次进行评分：无查询对照抑制共享注意力响应，而归一化熵衡量每个块内正向响应的广度。高分块进入持久证据白名单，并被纳入推理上下文。不确定块留在推理上下文之外，但保留在候选缓存中，可在之后重新评估时被检索。QRAE既不需要额外的生成式压缩过程，也不需要修改注意力算子。在多个DeepSearch基准和推理模型上，QRAE将任务成功率平均提高2.35个百分点，并将端到端延迟和报告的token使用量分别平均降低30%和45%。这些收益可推广到参数接近100B的模型。

papers.title: Identifying and targeting the Mg-Fe-PmrAB regulatory circuit reverses phosphate starvation-driven polymyxin tolerance in Enterobacteriaceae
papers.translated_title: 识别并靶向Mg-Fe-PmrAB调控回路可逆转肠杆菌科中磷酸盐饥饿驱动的多粘菌素耐受性
papers.author: ZHANG, G.
papers.summary: Phosphate (Pi) scarcity, a pervasive stressor prevalent in bacterial infections and dysbiotic host environments, potently alters antimicrobial susceptibility against cationic antibiotics like polymyxins across diverse bacterial taxa. While established Pi depletion-induced antimicrobial tolerance mechanisms often involve membrane phospholipid remodelling, Enterobacteriaceae largely lack these pathways, leaving the mechanism underlying their adaptation to Pi scarcity unresolved. Here, we reveal that Pi limitation robustly induces polymyxin tolerance in Enterobacteriaceae through 4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose (L-Ara4N) modification of the Gram-negative outer membrane component lipid A, reflecting a distinct adaptive strategy. This modification is driven by strong arn operon induction, mediated by the PmrAB two-component system. We discover that Pi depletion triggers cellular Mg2+ release, prompting compensatory Fe3+ mobilization to the cell envelope that directly activates PmrAB. Crucially, this metal-dependent signaling axis offers a directly targetable mechanism for reversing polymyxin tolerance, a significant deviation from the less accessible, PhoBR-regulated phospholipid remodelling strategies in other bacteria. We demonstrate that Mg2+ supplementation or Fe3+ chelation effectively suppresses PmrAB activation and restores polymyxin susceptibility, thereby establishing a novel, metal-centric paradigm for understanding and pharmacological intervention in stress-induced antimicrobial tolerance.
papers.translated_summary: 磷酸盐缺乏是细菌感染和菌群失调宿主环境中普遍存在的应激因素，能显著改变多种细菌类群对多粘菌素等阳离子抗生素的抗菌敏感性。尽管已知的磷酸盐耗竭诱导的抗菌耐受机制通常涉及膜磷脂重塑，但肠杆菌科细菌大多缺乏这些途径，使其适应磷酸盐缺乏的机制尚未阐明。在此，我们揭示磷酸盐限制通过革兰氏阴性外膜成分脂质A的4-氨基-4-脱氧-L-阿拉伯糖修饰，强烈诱导肠杆菌科细菌对多粘菌素的耐受，反映了一种独特的适应策略。这种修饰由PmrAB双组分系统介导的arn操纵子强烈诱导所驱动。我们发现磷酸盐耗竭触发细胞Mg2+释放，促使补偿性Fe3+向细胞包膜动员，直接激活PmrAB。关键在于，这一金属依赖性信号轴提供了可直接靶向的机制来逆转多粘菌素耐受，这与其他细菌中较难触及的PhoBR调控的磷脂重塑策略有显著差异。我们证明补充Mg2+或螯合Fe3+能有效抑制PmrAB激活并恢复多粘菌素敏感性，从而为理解和药物干预应激诱导的抗菌耐受建立了一种新的、以金属为中心的范式。

papers.title: Environmental DNA reveals biotic homogenization alongside elevated native and non-native species richness in marinas, supporting an ecological portuarization syndrome
papers.translated_title: 环境DNA揭示了游艇码头中生物同质化与本地和外来物种丰富度升高并存的现象，支持了一种生态港口化综合征
papers.author: Lilli, G.
papers.summary: The global expansion of ports has created novel marine urban ecosystems that remain understudied. Recent evidence suggests that ports promote distinct evolutionary trajectories due to their unique environmental conditions and the continuous introduction of non-indigenous species (NIS), a phenomenon previously coined the `biological portuarization syndrome`. In this study, we examine the ecological dimension of this concept by using environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding, to compare animal assemblages in 12 recreational ports (i.e., marinas) with those found in adjacent natural habitats in the north-western Mediterranean Sea. By combining three markers, we identified 536 species belonging to 18 phyla, including 50 species classified as non-indigenous or cryptogenic based on previous records from traditional surveys. Our results reveal marked differences in both taxonomic and functional composition between marinas and natural communities. Notably, contrary to expectations of reduced species richness due to environmental filtering in marinas, we observed higher species richness in these habitats. This was true even when considering native species alone, and it was broadly consistent across phyla: nine phyla exhibited significantly higher species richness in marinas, eight showed no significant difference between habitats, and only one (Arthropoda) had higher species richness in natural habitats. Furthermore, consistent with the hypothesis of biotic homogenization in anthropogenic habitats, animal assemblages were more homogeneous among marinas than among natural habitats. Overall, our findings show the impact of human-made habitats on regional biodiversity patterns, and suggest that the biological portuarization syndrome extends beyond evolutionary processes to include distinctive ecological patterns.
papers.translated_summary: 全球港口的扩张创造了新型海洋城市生态系统，这些系统仍缺乏充分研究。近期证据表明，由于港口独特的环境条件和持续引入的非本土物种（NIS），港口促进了独特的进化轨迹，这一现象此前被命名为“生物港口化综合征”。在本研究中，我们通过环境DNA（eDNA）宏条形码技术考察这一概念的生态维度，比较地中海西北部12个休闲港口（即游艇码头）与邻近自然栖息地中的动物群落。通过结合三种标记，我们鉴定出隶属于18个门的536个物种，其中包括根据以往传统调查记录归类为非本土或隐存种的50个物种。我们的结果揭示了游艇码头与自然群落在分类和功能组成上的显著差异。值得注意的是，与因游艇码头环境过滤而导致物种丰富度降低的预期相反，我们观察到这些栖息地中物种丰富度更高。即使仅考虑本土物种也是如此，且这一模式在各门中大体一致：九个门在游艇码头中表现出显著更高的物种丰富度，八个门在两种栖息地之间无显著差异，仅有一个门（节肢动物门）在自然栖息地中物种丰富度更高。此外，与人为栖息地生物同质化假说一致，游艇码头之间的动物群落比自然栖息地之间更为同质。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了人造栖息地对区域生物多样性格局的影响，并表明生物港口化综合征不仅限于进化过程，还包括独特的生态格局。

papers.title: Scalable methylome-transcriptome profiling resolves clonal organization in human hematopoiesis
papers.translated_title: 可扩展的甲基化组-转录组图谱解析人类造血中的克隆组织
papers.author: Shao, J.
papers.summary: Understanding human tissue maintenance and remodeling requires linking clonal ancestry to molecular state, yet scalable joint measurement remains challenging. Here, we introduce Droplet-MT and an integrated computational workflow for joint transcriptome and methylome profiling at ~10,000 cells per library. Methylation epimutations enable mutation-independent clonal reconstruction from high-coverage methylomes, while reference-based label transfer assigns cells to established clones at ~0.2% CpG coverage, reducing sequencing cost. Clone-aggregated somatic variants provide genetic annotation without additional single-cell genotyping. Across ~21,000 paired profiles from healthy blood and longitudinal acute myeloid leukemia, we resolved small and expanded clones with heterogeneous lineage output. In leukemia, the framework distinguished changes in malignant clonal abundance, state remodeling within persistent clones, and recovery of healthy polyclonal hematopoiesis. Malignant monocytes remained transcriptionally and epigenetically distinct from healthy and recovery-associated cells despite treatment-associated remodeling. Droplet-MT enables scalable analysis of human tissues by linking clonal organization with molecular state and retrospective genetic annotation.
papers.translated_summary: 理解人体组织的维持与重塑需要将克隆来源与分子状态联系起来，然而可扩展的联合测量仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们推出Droplet-MT以及一套集成计算工作流程，用于每文库约10,000个细胞的转录组与甲基化组联合分析。甲基化表观突变使得能够从高覆盖甲基化组中进行不依赖突变的克隆重建，而基于参考的标签转移可在约0.2%的CpG覆盖度下将细胞分配至已建立的克隆，从而降低测序成本。克隆聚合的体细胞变异无需额外的单细胞基因分型即可提供遗传注释。在来自健康血液和纵向急性髓系白血病的约21,000个配对图谱中，我们解析了具有异质性谱系输出的小克隆和扩增克隆。在白血病中，该框架区分了恶性克隆丰度的变化、持续克隆内的状态重塑以及健康多克隆造血功能的恢复。尽管存在治疗相关重塑，恶性单核细胞在转录和表观遗传上仍与健康和恢复相关细胞保持明显区别。Droplet-MT通过将克隆组织与分子状态及回溯性遗传注释联系起来，实现了对人体组织的可扩展分析。

papers.title: Kinship, acoustic signaling, and socio-spatial structure shape shared decisions and social influence in white-nosed coatis
papers.translated_title: 亲缘关系、声学信号和社会空间结构塑造了白鼻浣熊的共享决策与社会影响力
papers.author: Winans, J. C.
papers.summary: When individual preferences for collective outcomes diverge, cohesive animal groups often coalesce on the majority opinion. However, majority-based decision rules may be counterbalanced by other factors, particularly in heterogeneous groups with differentiated social relationships, and these factors could produce inequality in social influence. We used multi-sensor tracking collars to collect detailed and simultaneous data on the movements and vocalizations of almost all members of three wild white-nosed coati (Nasua narica) groups, and analyzed 2,401 individual decisions between conflicting travel directions that were indicated by acoustically signaling groupmates. Decision-making was shared: individuals favored directions that had majority support, and we found evidence that they used acoustic signals and movement cues to infer majority support. Individuals were also more likely to choose directions favored by closer kin and by groupmates in more frontward spatial positions. Although decisions were shared, influence was not equally distributed across individuals. Individuals who consistently formed majorities or occupied frontward spatial positions had higher influence over travel direction. By explicitly linking decisions by individual followers to emergent patterns of influence among potential leaders, our results suggest that influence is a complex product of higher-order interactions that are likely dependent on group demography and socio-spatial structure.
papers.translated_summary: 当个体对集体结果的偏好出现分歧时，具有凝聚力的动物群体通常会聚集到多数意见上。然而，基于多数的决策规则可能被其他因素所制衡，尤其是在具有差异化社会关系的异质群体中，这些因素可能产生社会影响力的不平等。我们使用多传感器追踪项圈，几乎同步收集了三个野生白鼻浣熊（Nasua narica）群体中几乎所有成员的运动和发声的详细数据，并分析了2，401次个体在相互冲突的行进方向之间的决策，这些方向由通过声音发出信号的同伴所指示。决策是共享的：个体倾向于支持获得多数支持的方向，并且我们发现了它们利用声音信号和运动线索来推断多数支持的证据。个体也更可能选择更近亲属以及处于更靠前空间位置的同伴所偏好的方向。尽管决策是共享的，但影响力在个体之间的分布并不平等。始终形成多数或占据靠前空间位置的个体对行进方向具有更高的影响力。通过明确地将个体跟随者的决策与潜在领导者之间涌现的影响力模式联系起来，我们的结果表明，影响力是更高阶相互作用的复杂产物，很可能依赖于群体人口结构和社会空间结构。

papers.title: Aggregate Deep Visual Proteomics reveals selective organization of α-synuclein inclusions
papers.translated_title: 聚集深度视觉蛋白质组学揭示α-突触核蛋白包涵体的选择性组织
papers.author: Oeller, M.
papers.summary: -Synuclein inclusions, the lesions typical of Parkinson's disease, have been interpreted as protective deposits, toxic species or failed degradation products, each predicting a different composition and correlating that enrichment with neuron dysfunction and eventual degeneration. Distinguishing them requires measuring what an inclusion concentrates relative to the cell that built it. Here we developed Aggregate Deep Visual Proteomics, which uses ultrasensitive mass spectrometry to profile laser-microdissected inclusions against the remainder of the same cell or a matched host. In HEK293 cells, iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and post-mortem patient brain, each inclusion concentrated a selective subset of its cell's proteome, independent of abundance and dominated by membrane, in neurons largely presynaptic. Inclusions took up whole assemblies, with subunits moving together in 421 of 438 complexes, and the V-ATPase alone was enriched in all three systems. Degradation cargo stayed with the receptors that route it, consistent with sequestration and failed degradation acting together. Neuritic and somatic inclusions differed, the former rich in UBQLN2 and the latter in intermediate filaments. In the cell line, phosphorylated -synuclein was tenfold higher in the inclusion than in the rest of the cell, with about one third of the rise already present before an inclusion was visible. Measured against its host, the composition of an inclusion becomes a readout of how it formed and a source of candidate markers and therapeutic targets.
papers.translated_summary: α-突触核蛋白包涵体是帕金森病的典型病变，曾被解释为保护性沉积物、毒性物种或降解失败的产物，每种解释都预测了不同的组成，并将这种富集与神经元功能障碍及最终的退行性变相关联。区分这些解释需要测量包涵体相对于构建它的细胞所浓缩的物质。在此，我们开发了聚集体深度视觉蛋白质组学，利用超灵敏质谱技术，将激光显微切割的包涵体与同一细胞剩余部分或匹配宿主进行对比分析。在HEK293细胞、iPSC来源的多巴胺能神经元和死后患者大脑中，每个包涵体都浓缩了其细胞蛋白质组中选择性的一部分，与丰度无关，且以膜蛋白为主，在神经元中主要为突触前蛋白。包涵体摄取了完整的组装体，在438个复合物中有421个亚基协同移动，仅V-ATPase在三个系统中均富集。降解货物与其路由受体共同存在，与隔离和降解失败共同作用的机制一致。神经突包涵体与胞体包涵体不同，前者富含UBQLN2，后者富含中间丝。在细胞系中，磷酸化α-突触核蛋白在包涵体中的含量是细胞其余部分的十倍，且在包涵体可见之前已有约三分之一的升高。相对于其宿主进行测量，包涵体的组成成为其形成方式的一种读数，也是候选标志物和治疗靶点的来源。

papers.title: Clinical-Anchored Incremental Survival Learning: A Stability-Constrained Framework for Molecularly Enhanced Survival Prediction in Lung Adenocarcinoma
papers.translated_title: 临床锚定的增量生存学习：一种用于肺腺癌分子增强生存预测的稳定性约束框架
papers.author: Shringarpure, P.
papers.summary: Accurate survival prediction in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains challenging because high-dimensional molecular data can introduce overfitting and unstable feature selection. We developed Clinical-Anchored Incremental Survival Learning (CAISL), a framework that integrates a sparse molecular risk correction with a clinical baseline to improve prognostic discrimination while constraining model complexity and prediction variability. CAISL was evaluated using The Cancer Genome Atlas LUAD cohort comprising 470 patients and 119 observed deaths. Performance was compared with clinical Cox, molecular-only, and unanchored multimodal models using five independently seeded, event-stratified five-fold cross-validation runs. CAISL achieved a mean concordance index (C-index) of 0.7246, compared with 0.6970 for clinical Cox, yielding an absolute improvement of 0.0276 (95% bootstrap confidence interval [CI], 0.005 to 0.050). Time-dependent discrimination was higher at three years (AUC, 0.742 vs. 0.712) and five years (AUC, 0.721 vs. 0.691), while the integrated Brier score was lower for CAISL than for clinical Cox (0.164 vs. 0.181). Ablation analysis identified clinical anchoring as the component associated with the largest reduction in discrimination when removed. Stability analysis showed a mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of 0.46 between selected feature sets and a mean Spearman correlation of 0.86 between molecular correction scores. These findings support the potential of clinically anchored, stability-constrained molecular learning to improve internal survival-risk prediction in LUAD. Independent-cohort validation is needed to establish generalizability.
papers.translated_summary: 肺腺癌（LUAD）的准确生存预测仍然具有挑战性，因为高维分子数据可能引入过拟合和不稳定的特征选择。我们开发了临床锚定增量生存学习（CAISL）框架，该框架将稀疏分子风险校正与临床基线相结合，以改善预后判别能力，同时约束模型复杂度和预测变异性。CAISL使用癌症基因组图谱LUAD队列进行评估，该队列包含470例患者和119例观察到的死亡事件。使用五次独立设种、按事件分层的五折交叉验证运行，将性能与临床Cox模型、仅分子模型和非锚定多模态模型进行比较。CAISL达到的平均一致性指数（C-index）为0.7246，而临床Cox模型为0.6970，绝对改善为0.0276（95% bootstrap置信区间[CI]，0.005至0.050）。时间依赖判别能力在三年时更高（AUC，0.742 vs. 0.712），在五年时也更高（AUC，0.721 vs. 0.691），而CAISL的积分Brier评分低于临床Cox模型（0.164 vs. 0.181）。消融分析确定临床锚定为移除后判别能力下降最大的组分。稳定性分析显示，所选特征集之间的平均成对Jaccard相似度为0.46，分子校正评分之间的平均Spearman相关系数为0.86。这些发现支持临床锚定、稳定性约束的分子学习在改善LUAD内部生存风险预测方面的潜力。尚需独立队列验证以确立泛化性。

papers.title: Amide I kurtosis maps cardiac amyloid in human tissue by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) microscopy
papers.translated_title: 酰胺I峰峭度通过超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）显微镜在人体组织中对心脏淀粉样变性进行成像
papers.author: Ota, K.
papers.summary: Cardiac amyloidosis is caused by deposits of misfolded proteins in the heart and can lead to heart failure. Histological confirmation typically involves staining tissue sections with Congo red and examining them under polarized light for apple-green birefringence; however, achieving an interpretable, label-free, and observer-independent assessment remains challenging. Here we show that Pearson kurtosis of channel intensities within the amide I window provides an interpretable, fitting-free contrast for cardiac amyloid in unstained human cardiac tissue sections imaged by ultrabroadband multiplex coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS). In two participants, high-kurtosis regions corresponded with Congo red-positive tissue in adjacent stained sections (descriptive spatial AUCs, 0.79 and 0.73). Across 15 fields from nine participants, including one of these two, kurtosis values did not overlap between severe-deposition and amyloid-negative tissue. Among the descriptors examined, kurtosis showed the largest standardized participant-level separation. Exploratory multivariate curve resolution yielded a deposit-associated component with aromatic-residue features shared with reagent transthyretin. Second harmonic generation (SHG), acquired simultaneously with CARS, showed a broadly inverse spatial pattern relative to kurtosis, providing complementary architectural contrast. These findings support a label-free approach to detecting cardiac amyloid deposits that combines broadband CARS-derived amide I kurtosis with SHG.
papers.translated_summary: 心脏淀粉样变性由错误折叠蛋白在心脏中的沉积引起，可导致心力衰竭。组织学确认通常包括用刚果红对组织切片进行染色，并在偏振光下检查苹果绿色双折射；然而，实现可解释、无标记且不依赖观察者的评估仍然具有挑战性。本研究表明，在超宽带多重相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）成像的未染色人心脏组织切片中，酰胺I窗口内通道强度的Pearson峰度可为心脏淀粉样变提供可解释、无需拟合的对比度。在两名参与者中，高峰度区域与相邻染色切片中刚果红阳性组织相对应（描述性空间AUC分别为0.79和0.73）。在来自九名参与者的15个视野中（包括这两名参与者中的一名），严重沉积组织与淀粉样阴性组织之间的峰度值没有重叠。在所检查的描述符中，峰度显示出最大的标准化参与者水平分离度。探索性多元曲线分辨 yielded 一个与沉积相关的组分，其芳香残基特征与试剂转甲状腺素蛋白共有。与CARS同时采集的二次谐波产生（SHG）显示出相对于峰度大致相反的空间模式，提供了互补的结构对比度。这些发现支持一种结合宽带CARS衍生的酰胺I峰度与SHG的无标记方法来检测心脏淀粉样沉积。

papers.title: Genomic prediction of resistance to Phytophthora megakarya in cacao from a sparse host-pathogen screen
papers.translated_title: 可可对巨大疫霉抗性的基因组预测：基于稀疏宿主-病原体筛选
papers.author: Schlathoelter, I.
papers.summary: Black pod rot caused by Phytophthora megakarya is a major disease impacting cacao (Theobroma cacao L.) production in West Africa. Resistance is influenced by genetic variation in both host and pathogen populations. While genomic prediction approaches have been widely applied in plant breeding, most studies incorporate only host genomic information. The value of explicitly modeling pathogen genomic relatedness in quantitative disease prediction remains largely unknown. We genotyped 947 clones from the International Cacao Collection at CATIE using a 10K-SNP panel and characterized 67 P. megakarya isolates by sequencing 3,505 virulence-associated genes and 2,774 SNP loci. Cacao clones were extensively admixed, while isolates formed three geographically structured subpopulations. Mixed linear models were fitted to lesion diameters on detached pods of 350 genotyped clones inoculated with 58 isolates in 30 bioassays, covering 5% of possible clone-by-isolate combinations. Differences among isolates explained a larger share of lesion-size variation than differences among clones (0.34 and 0.27 of phenotypic variance, respectively). After accounting for broad pathogen subpopulation structure, incorporating within-subpopulation genomic relatedness among isolates improved neither model fit nor prediction, whereas incorporating genomic relationships among cacao clones improved model fit and enabled prediction of phenotypically untested clones with a predictive ability of 0.41. Clone rankings were stable across pathogen subpopulations (genomic correlation 0.86 {+/-} 0.06), whereas clone-by-isolate interactions accounted for little phenotypic variation and were not resolved with confidence in the sparse design. An exploratory ancestry analysis associated several Upper Amazon ancestry components with smaller predicted lesions. These are the first genomic predictions of resistance to P. megakarya in cacao. In this strongly structured host-pathogen system, genomic relationships among hosts carried most of the predictable signal beyond broad pathogen subpopulation effects, and the predictions provide a starting point for prioritizing screening and selection efforts.
papers.translated_summary: 由Phytophthora megakarya引起的黑果腐病是影响西非可可（Theobroma cacao L.）生产的主要病害。抗性受寄主和病原群体遗传变异的影响。虽然基因组预测方法已广泛应用于植物育种，但大多数研究仅纳入寄主基因组信息。在定量病害预测中明确建模病原基因组亲缘关系的价值在很大程度上仍不清楚。我们使用10K-SNP芯片对来自CATIE国际可可种质库的947个无性系进行了基因分型，并通过测序3,505个毒力相关基因和2,774个SNP位点对67株P. megakarya分离株进行了表征。可可无性系广泛混血，而分离株形成三个地理结构化的亚群体。混合线性模型拟合于30次生物测定中350个基因分型无性系离体果荚接种58株分离株的病斑直径，覆盖了可能无性系×分离株组合的5%。分离株间差异解释的病斑大小变异份额大于无性系间差异（分别占表型方差的0.34和0.27）。在考虑广泛的病原亚群体结构后，纳入分离株间亚群体内基因组亲缘关系既未改善模型拟合也未改善预测，而纳入可可无性系间基因组关系则改善了模型拟合，并能够以0.41的预测能力预测表型未测试的无性系。无性系排名在病原亚群体间保持稳定（基因组相关0.86 {+/-} 0.06），而无性系×分离株互作解释的表型变异很小，且在稀疏设计中未能以置信度解析。一项探索性祖先分析将若干上亚马逊祖先成分与较小的预测病斑相关联。这些是可可中对P. megakarya抗性的首批基因组预测。在这个强结构化的寄主-病原系统中，寄主间的基因组关系承载了超越广泛病原亚群体效应的大部分可预测信号，这些预测为优先筛选和选择工作提供了起点。

papers.title: Gene regulatory architecture in antibiotic resistance is optimized for specific dynamic regimens
papers.translated_title: 抗生素耐药性中的基因调控架构针对特定动态给药方案进行了优化
papers.author: Geng, H.
papers.summary: Cellular responses to antibiotics face a fundamental trade-off: resistance must be deployed quickly enough to prevent the accumulation of drug inside the cell, but expression of resistance genes is costly in the absence of the drug. Therefore, antibiotic responses are typically regulated, controlling not only whether resistance is expressed, but also when, how strongly, and for how long. These regulatory strategies are implemented through the strength and arrangement of promoters and operators. However, it is still not clear how the dynamics of drug exposure select for specific regulatory strategies. Here, we develop a dynamical model of a typical antibiotic response, where a transcriptional repressor senses the drug and regulates expression of a resistance protein, coupled to the effects of the drug on cell growth and gene expression. We define a cost function that weighs the different burdens imposed on the cell over the course of the response, and perform in silico optimization of the regulatory parameters under different selective pressures for three architectures of increasing complexity: constitutive expression of resistance, repression by a constitutively expressed repressor, and repression by a self-regulated repressor. We find that strong drug exposures favor constitutive expression of resistance, high costs of basal expression favor repression by a constitutive repressor, and self-regulation of the repressor is favored only when the response must provide protection while also restraining overexpression of resistance. Stochastic simulations further show that self-regulation of the repressor protects cells against fluctuations in repressor levels, which cause unnecessary induction of resistance before exposure and failed induction after exposure. This framework links the dynamics of the environment to the evolution of gene regulation, providing a basis to predict which regulatory strategies are expected to arise under specific selective pressures.
papers.translated_summary: 细胞对抗生素的响应面临一个基本权衡：耐药性必须被足够快速地部署，以防止药物在细胞内积累，但在没有药物的情况下，耐药基因的表达是有代价的。因此，抗生素响应通常受到调控，不仅控制耐药性是否表达，还控制何时表达、表达强度以及持续多长时间。这些调控策略通过启动子和操纵子的强度与排列方式来实现。然而，目前仍不清楚药物暴露的动态如何选择特定的调控策略。在此，我们建立了一个典型抗生素响应的动力学模型，其中转录阻遏蛋白感知药物并调控耐药蛋白的表达，同时耦合药物对细胞生长和基因表达的影响。我们定义了一个代价函数，权衡响应过程中施加于细胞的不同负担，并针对三种复杂度递增的架构——耐药性的组成型表达、由组成型表达的阻遏蛋白进行的阻遏、以及由自我调控的阻遏蛋白进行的阻遏——在不同选择压力下进行调控参数的计算机优化。我们发现，强药物暴露有利于耐药性的组成型表达，高基础表达代价有利于由组成型阻遏蛋白进行的阻遏，而只有当响应必须提供保护同时还要抑制耐药性过表达时，阻遏蛋白的自我调控才被青睐。随机模拟进一步表明，阻遏蛋白的自我调控保护细胞免受阻遏蛋白水平波动的影响，这种波动会导致暴露前不必要的耐药性诱导以及暴露后诱导失败。该框架将环境的动态与基因调控的演化联系起来，为预测在特定选择压力下预期会出现哪些调控策略提供了基础。

papers.title: Identification of T-Cell specific signature miRNAs and target pathways in Psoriasis
papers.translated_title: 银屑病中T细胞特异性特征miRNA及其靶通路的鉴定
papers.author: Madaan, P.
papers.summary: Psoriasis is a chronic skin disease characterized by keratinocyte hyperproliferation, involving T cells as the major players in the manifestation of lesional and systemic inflammation. With the extensive exploration of keratinocyte dysfunctionality, T cell centric deregulation has gained much focus with limited molecular understanding in the context of disease etiology. miRNAs, the molecular switches known to drive disease manifestation via altering keratinocyte biology, have not been much studied in the context of T cell alterations. This study aims to explore T cell-associated miRNAs and their target signaling networks to understand their role in modulating psoriasis specific T cell changes. miRNAs with altered expression in psoriatic T cells were identified through a comprehensive analysis of the available literature and datasets. The relevant miRNAs were used for prediction and enrichment of cognate targets and mapping of associated pathways involved in different modalities of T cell functionality. The study identified 14 miRNAs dysregulated in psoriatic T cells along with 256 downstream targets involved in 15 distinct T cell associated signaling pathways. 5/14 miRNAs identified were further validated with a significant increase in their expression in enriched CD3+T cells from blood of psoriatic patients versus healthy subjects. The psoriatic T cell specific miRNA driven signaling cascades identified were modelled to propose yet unexplored molecular basis of dysregulated T cell activation, proliferation, survival, and subset differentiation associated with the disease. The new findings delineate candidate miRNA target signaling components that need to be validated in T cell disease etiology. Importantly, the key miRNAs/targets can be employed towards psoriasis-specific diagnostics and therapeutic interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 银屑病是一种慢性皮肤病，以角质形成细胞过度增殖为特征，其中T细胞是皮损及全身炎症表现的主要参与者。随着对角质形成细胞功能障碍的广泛探索，以T细胞为中心的失调调控受到了大量关注，但在疾病病因学背景下其分子机制理解仍然有限。miRNA作为已知通过改变角质形成细胞生物学来驱动疾病表现的分子开关，在T细胞改变的背景下尚未得到充分研究。本研究旨在探索T细胞相关miRNA及其靶信号网络，以理解其在调控银屑病特异性T细胞变化中的作用。通过对现有文献和数据集的综合分析，鉴定了在银屑病T细胞中表达改变的miRNA。相关miRNA被用于预测和富集同源靶标，并映射涉及T细胞不同功能模式的相关通路。该研究鉴定了14个在银屑病T细胞中失调的miRNA，以及256个参与15条不同T细胞相关信号通路的下游靶标。所鉴定的5/14个miRNA在银屑病患者血液富集CD3+T细胞中较健康受试者表达显著增加，得到了进一步验证。所鉴定的银屑病T细胞特异性miRNA驱动信号级联被建模，以提出与该疾病相关的T细胞活化、增殖、存活和亚群分化失调的尚未探索的分子基础。这些新发现描绘了需要在T细胞疾病病因学中验证的候选miRNA靶信号组分。重要的是，关键miRNA/靶标可用于银屑病特异性诊断和治疗干预。

papers.title: Feeling Too Much or Too Little: Alexithymia Moderates How Self-Reported Physiological Hyperarousal Shapes Risky Decisions
papers.translated_title: 感受过多或过少：述情障碍调节自我报告的生理过度唤醒如何影响风险决策
papers.author: Molins, F.
papers.summary: Background: Embodied cognition frameworks propose that physiological states shape decision-making, yet the contribution of sustained threat-related hyperarousal and individual differences in interoceptive integration remains poorly understood. This study examined whether self-reported physiological hyperarousal predicted Prospect Theory decision parameters: loss aversion, value sensitivity, and choice consistency; and whether alexithymia moderated these associations. Methods: Sixty-eight healthy young adults (M age = 18.94, SD = 1.46; 85% women) completed the DASS-21 anxiety subscale as a measure of hyperarousal, the TAS-20 as a measure of alexithymia, and a 64-trial Mixed Gambles Task; individual Prospect Theory parameters were estimated via hierarchical Bayesian analysis. Moderation analyses were conducted using Hayes' PROCESS macro with Johnson-Neyman probing. Results: Self-reported hyperarousal negatively predicted choice consistency and value sensitivity, but not loss aversion. Alexithymia moderated both effects through distinct conditional patterns: the self-reported hyperarousal-choice consistency association was significant only below a TAS-20 threshold of 51.05 (67.65% of the sample), reflecting monotonic buffering; the self-reported hyperarousal value sensitivity association was significant within a bounded TAS-20 range (45.31-66.08), suggesting that intermediate alexithymia constitutes a zone of maximal vulnerability, though this model only reached trend significance and should be treated as exploratory. No effects emerged for loss aversion. Conclusion: These findings indicate that sustained hyperarousal could selectively degrade evaluative precision and decision consistency, while leaving loss aversion intact. Alexithymia may operate as a stage-specific, conditional moderator of the body-decision relationship.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：具身认知框架提出生理状态塑造决策，但持续性威胁相关高唤醒以及内感受整合的个体差异所起的作用仍知之甚少。本研究考察自我报告的生理性高唤醒是否预测前景理论的决策参数：损失厌恶、价值敏感性和选择一致性；以及述情障碍是否调节这些关联。方法：68名健康年轻成人（平均年龄=18.94，标准差=1.46；85%为女性）完成了DASS-21焦虑分量表作为高唤醒的测量、TAS-20作为述情障碍的测量，以及一项64试次的混合赌博任务；个体前景理论参数通过分层贝叶斯分析估计。调节分析使用Hayes的PROCESS宏并结合Johnson-Neyman探针进行。结果：自我报告的高唤醒负向预测选择一致性和价值敏感性，但不预测损失厌恶。述情障碍通过不同的条件模式调节了这两种效应：自我报告的高唤醒-选择一致性关联仅在TAS-20阈值51.05以下显著（占样本的67.65%），反映单调缓冲；自我报告的高唤醒-价值敏感性关联在有界的TAS-20范围内（45.31-66.08）显著，提示中等程度的述情障碍构成最大脆弱性区域，尽管该模型仅达到趋势显著，应视为探索性。损失厌恶未出现任何效应。结论：这些发现表明，持续性高唤醒可能选择性地降低评估精度和决策一致性，同时保持损失厌恶完整。述情障碍可能作为身体-决策关系的阶段特异性、条件性调节因素发挥作用。

papers.title: Place-based structural disadvantage and mortality inequality across 379 Polish counties, 2010-2025: a spatial Mundlak analysis
papers.translated_title: 基于地点的结构性劣势与2010-2025年波兰379个县的死亡率不平等：一项空间Mundlak分析
papers.author: Madej, T.
papers.summary: Place-based mortality inequalities may persist even as short-term associations with local conditions change. We examined age-sex-standardised all-cause mortality in 379 harmonised Polish counties (2010-2025), asking whether durable between-county differences or lagged within-county deviations better characterise mortality geography. Spatial Mundlak generalised additive models allowed non-linear associations and county-specific spatial modification; a pre-COVID model (2010-2019) was compared with overlapping models through 2022 and 2025. In the pre-COVID model, median county average partial slopes per standard deviation were -26.1 deaths per 100,000 for higher education, +29.4 for primary/lower-secondary education and +30.2 for PM2.5. Directions of these between-county gradients persisted across analytical windows. By contrast, within-county associations were less stable and sometimes reversed sign in pandemic-inclusive models. County-level uncertainty indicated stronger and more coherent pre-COVID spatial patterns for education, PM2.5 and population density than for several health-care and migration terms. Strict leave-one-year-out validation revealed weak temporal transportability, particularly for the 2010-2022 model, limiting predictive interpretation. Outcome-defined comparisons further showed that educational composition remained an important separator of high- and low-mortality counties after COVID-19, while the fitted PM2.5 contribution contrast diminished. These findings distinguish durable configurations of place-based disadvantage from period-dependent ecological co-movement. They support geographically sensitive, multi-domain approaches to reducing mortality inequalities, while not establishing individual-level causal effects.
papers.translated_summary: 基于地点的死亡率不平等可能在与当地条件的短期关联发生变化时依然持续存在。我们考察了379个统一口径的波兰县（2010—2025年）的年龄—性别标准化全因死亡率，追问持久的县际差异还是滞后的县内偏差更能刻画死亡率地理格局。空间Mundlak广义可加模型允许非线性关联和县特定空间修饰；将COVID前模型（2010—2019年）与截至2022年和2025年的重叠模型进行比较。在COVID前模型中，每标准差对应的县平均偏斜率中位数为：高等教育−26.1例死亡/10万，小学/初中教育+29.4，PM2.5+30.2。这些县际梯度的方向在各分析窗口间持续存在。相比之下，县内关联较不稳定，在纳入大流行期的模型中有时符号反转。县级不确定性表明，教育、PM2.5和人口密度的COVID前空间格局比若干医疗保健和迁移项更强、更一致。严格的留一年验证显示时间可迁移性较弱，尤其是2010—2022年模型，限制了预测性解读。结果定义的比较进一步表明，COVID-19后教育构成仍是高死亡率和低死亡率县的重要区分因素，而拟合的PM2.5贡献对比减弱。这些发现将基于地点的劣势的持久配置与依赖时期的生态共变区分开来。它们支持以地理敏感、多领域的方法减少死亡率不平等，但并未确立个体层面的因果效应。

papers.title: Smaller Cortical Responses to Balance Perturbations in Parkinson's Disease with Freezing of Gait
papers.translated_title: 帕金森病伴冻结步态患者对平衡扰动的皮层反应减弱
papers.author: Monaghan, A. S.
papers.summary: Freezing of gait (FoG) is among the most disabling symptoms of Parkinson's disease (PD) and is associated with balance impairment and increased falls risk, yet remains challenging to understand due to its episodic and context-dependent nature. Altered supplementary motor area (SMA) function at rest and before self-initiated movements has been implicated in FoG; however, whether this extends to functionally relevant balance behavior is unknown. A loss of balance in response to support surface translations during standing elicits a perturbation-evoked N1 potential, an error assessment signal linked to SMA activity. We therefore predicted that people with FoG would have smaller and later N1 responses than people with PD without FoG and older adults. We recorded electroencephalography (EEG) during backward support-surface translations in 29 people with PD (71 {+/-} 7 years), including 13 people with a history of FoG (FoG+) and 16 people without FoG (FoG-), and 26 older adults (OA; 67 {+/-} 6 years). N1 amplitude and latency were quantified at a central midline electrode and defined as the largest negative peak 100-300 ms post-perturbation. N1 responses were similar between OA and FoG- ({Delta} = 4.0 {micro}V and 2.8 ms, respectively). In contrast, FoG+ had smaller N1 amplitudes than FoG- ({Delta} = 18.1 {micro}V, p = 0.001) and OA ({Delta} = 14.1 {micro}V, p = 0.003), and both differences persisted after adjusting for age. FoG+ also had later N1 latencies than OA ({Delta} = 26.5 ms, p = 0.029), with a similar but non-significant difference versus FoG- ({Delta} = 23.6 ms, p = 0.091); after adjusting for age, these latency differences were not retained. These findings suggest that perturbation-evoked cortical activity is altered in FoG, potentially reflecting altered SMA function, and may provide a functionally relevant marker of FoG susceptibility.

papers.title: Scleral Allograft-Reinforced Cyclodialysis Combined with Phacoemulsification or Performed as a Standalone Procedure: 24-Month Outcomes from the Multicenter CREST Study
papers.translated_title: 巩膜同种异体移植增强的睫状体分离术联合超声乳化或作为独立手术实施：多中心CREST研究的24个月结果
papers.author: Weinreb, R. N.
papers.summary: Introduction: Acellular scleral allograft-reinforced cyclodialysis is a bio-interventional surgery (BIOS) to lower intraocular pressure (IOP). We report 2-year efficacy and safety outcomes when the procedure is performed in combination with phacoemulsification and as a standalone procedure in eyes with open-angle glaucoma. Methods: Analysis of the multicenter CREST real-world evidence study of eyes undergoing allograft-reinforced cyclodialysis with AlloFlo Uveo (Iantrek, Inc., White Plains, NY; NCT05506423). Eyes attending the Month-24 visit were analyzed: 176 eyes undergoing phaco-combined surgery (Cohort 1) and 32 standalone eyes (Cohort 2). Values recorded after secondary procedures censored. Cohort 1 only was stratified by low, moderate, or high baseline IOP ([≤] 15, 16-20, [≥] 21 mmHg). Results: A total of 176 eyes in Cohort 1 and 32 in Cohort 2 were analyzed. In Cohort 1, IOP decreased 3.1 mmHg at Month 24 from a baseline of 18.0 (-12.5%; p < 0.001), and medications decreased 0.5 from 1.5 (p < 0.001); medication-free eyes rose from 22.9% to 46.4% (p < 0.001). IOP changes in the low, moderate, and high baseline tiers were +0.9 (+7.8%), -3.0 (-16.3%), and -9.2 (-36.1%) mmHg; medication changes were -0.8, -0.6, and +0.1. In Cohort 2, IOP decreased 6.4 mmHg from 20.0 (-27.1%; p < 0.001), and medications decreased 1.2 from 2.8 (p = 0.004); medication-free eyes rose from 4.3% to 30.4% (p = 0.031). Secondary IOP-lowering procedures were performed in 5.1% of Cohort 1 eyes and 28.1% of Cohort 2. Kaplan-Meier freedom from reoperation was 98.9% and 84.4%. No eye developed clinically significant hypotony or choroidal effusion, and there were no allograft-related vision-threatening adverse events. Conclusion: Allograft-reinforced cyclodialysis effectively lowered IOP and medication use through 24 months.

papers.title: First-trimester nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling during home sleep testing and later pregnancy complications: a secondary analysis of the nuMoM2b cohort
papers.translated_title: 妊娠早期家庭睡眠监测中的夜间心肺耦合与后续妊娠并发症：nuMoM2b队列的二次分析
papers.author: Wu, Y.
papers.summary: We tested whether direction-specific nocturnal cardiorespiratory coupling (CRC) in the first trimester differed in pregnancies that later developed obstetric complications. The analysis included 2504 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort with valid level 3 home sleep recordings at 6-13 weeks' gestation. Bidirectional CRC between RR intervals and abdominal respiratory effort was quantified using bivariate phase-rectified signal averaging in consecutive 5-min segments. Coupling strength, local transition dynamics, and waveform irregularity were summarized by nightly mean and standard deviation. Associations with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM; n = 111), preeclampsia (n = 149), preterm birth (n = 192), and fetal macrosomia (n = 186) were examined using proportional-odds models with CRC feature quintile as the ordered outcome. Models included all four complications simultaneously and adjusted for maternal age, pre-pregnancy body mass index, race and ethnicity, gestational age at recording, relevant medical and family history, medication use, and apnea-hypopnea index >5 events/h. Holm correction was applied across outcomes. GDM was associated with lower respiration-to-heart rate coupling strength (cumulative odds ratio, 0.45; 95% CI, 0.31-0.64; P < 0.001) and shallower slope at the anchor point (0.63; 0.45-0.89; P = 0.03). Fetal macrosomia was associated with lower within-night variability in heart rate-to-respiration waveform irregularity (0.59; 0.45-0.77; P < 0.001). No associations with preeclampsia or preterm birth remained significant after correction. Direction-specific differences in nocturnal CRC were detectable in the first trimester in pregnancies that later developed GDM or resulted in fetal macrosomia.

papers.title: Efficacy and Clinical Predictors of Topical NSAIDs as Bridging Therapy for Diabetic Macular Edema: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.translated_title: 局部非甾体抗炎药作为糖尿病黄斑水肿桥接治疗的疗效与临床预测因素：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Roikhan, M. A.
papers.summary: Introduction & Objectives: Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) is a primary cause of vision loss. While anti-VEGF injections are the gold standard, prolonged referral delays in primary care settings often lead to irreversible photoreceptor damage. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of topical Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) as a temporary bridging therapy and to develop a new clinical scoring system to guide primary care physicians in early intervention. Methods: A systematic review was conducted to identify clinical predictors of responses to topical NSAIDs in DME patients, followed by a meta-analysis to calculate pooled Odds Ratios (OR) for each predictor. These values underwent natural log transformation (beta = ln(OR)) to derive a point-based clinical scoring system. Result: Twelve studies were analyzed. Predictor variables and assigned points derived from pooled ORs included: glycemic control (HbA1c < 8.0%; OR 2.41, 9 points), symptom duration (< 6 months; OR 2.11, 7 points), baseline visual acuity (> 6/12; OR 1.96, 7 points), and retinopathy stage (mild-to-moderate NPDR; OR 1.77, 5 points). The proposed 28-point scoring system categorizes patients into three tiers: High Probability (21-28 points) for immediate NSAID initiation; Moderate Probability (12-20 points) for combined systemic optimization; and Low Probability (0-11 points) for prioritized emergency referral. Evidence confirms that potent topical NSAIDs effectively stabilize macular thickness and prevent exudative progression during the referral window. Conclusion: This study concludes that the OR-derived scoring system effectively empowers primary care physicians to manage DME during referral windows. Topical NSAIDs serve as a safe, low-risk bridging strategy to mitigate permanent vision loss and reduce the burden of blindness in resource-limited settings.
papers.translated_summary: 引言与目标：糖尿病性黄斑水肿（DME）是视力丧失的主要原因。尽管抗VEGF注射是金标准，但初级保健环境中转诊延迟往往导致不可逆的光感受器损伤。本研究旨在评估局部非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）作为临时桥接治疗的疗效，并开发一种新的临床评分系统，以指导初级保健医生进行早期干预。方法：通过系统综述识别DME患者对局部NSAIDs反应的临床预测因素，随后进行荟萃分析以计算每个预测因素的合并比值比（OR）。这些值经过自然对数转换（beta = ln(OR)）以推导出基于积分的临床评分系统。结果：共分析12项研究。由合并OR得出的预测变量及赋值积分包括：血糖控制（HbA1c < 8.0%；OR 2.41，9分）、症状持续时间（< 6个月；OR 2.11，7分）、基线视力（> 6/12；OR 1.96，7分）以及视网膜病变分期（轻至中度NPDR；OR 1.77，5分）。所提出的28分评分系统将患者分为三个层级：高概率（21-28分）立即启动NSAID治疗；中等概率（12-20分）联合全身优化治疗；低概率（0-11分）优先紧急转诊。证据证实，强效局部NSAIDs在转诊窗口期内有效稳定黄斑厚度并防止渗出性进展。结论：本研究得出结论，基于OR推导的评分系统有效赋能初级保健医生在转诊窗口期管理DME。局部NSAIDs作为一种安全、低风险的桥接策略，可减轻永久性视力丧失，并减少资源有限环境中盲症负担。

papers.title: Limits of Sociodemographic Data for Predicting Postpartum Readmission: Conventional, Ensemble and Automated Machine Learning Compared at Equal Workload, With a Decision-Economic Analysis
papers.translated_title: 社会人口学数据在预测产后再入院方面的局限性：在相同工作量下比较传统、集成和自动化机器学习，并进行决策经济分析
papers.author: Frasch, M. G.
papers.summary: Objective: Postpartum readmission is rare and costly, and risk tools often rely on routinely collected sociodemographic data. We asked what such data can support, whether algorithm choice matters, and when a modest model could pay for itself. Methods: We analyzed 8,774 participants of the nuMoM2b cohort of first pregnancies, of whom 154 (1.8%) were readmitted within 14 days. Conventional, ensemble and automated machine learning models (FLAML, AutoGluon) were trained on 70% of participants, with every fitted step confined to training data, and evaluated once on the remaining 30% (46 readmissions). We compared models at default thresholds and equal screening workload, after recalibration, across richer feature sets, and in economic scenarios against contacting all or no patients. Results: The best model, a tuned logistic regression, reached an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.614 (95% confidence interval 0.542-0.685). Both automated frameworks discriminated worse (AUC 0.416-0.519) after optimistic internal validation. Sensitivity at the default threshold ranged from 0% to 41% and reflected class-imbalance corrections rather than ranking ability; when every model flagged the same 28.4% of patients, conventional and ensemble models reached 11 to 20 of 46 readmissions. After recalibration, no model improved on predicting the base rate. Delivery and discharge information raised the AUC to 0.611-0.631, and learning curves were flat. Reweighted post hoc to each US state's first births, the AUC ranged from 0.531 to 0.667, lowest in the least diverse states. Contacting everyone was optimal for low-cost outreach; near the break-even cost, no model gained more than its running cost. Conclusions: Sociodemographic data alone cannot support a useful postpartum readmission tool, whatever the algorithm. Under class imbalance, default-threshold comparisons mislead. A modest model's value depends on the population and the intervention, which decision-economic analysis, not discrimination alone, should assess. Future work should prioritize richer peripartum and postpartum data.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：产后再入院虽不常见但费用高昂，风险工具往往依赖常规收集的社会人口学数据。我们探讨此类数据能支持什么、算法选择是否重要，以及一个适度的模型何时能实现自身成本回收。方法：我们分析了nuMoM2b首次妊娠队列的8，774名参与者，其中154名（1.8%）在14天内再入院。传统、集成和自动化机器学习模型（FLAML、AutoGluon）在70%的参与者上训练，每个拟合步骤均限于训练数据，并在其余30%（46例再入院）上一次性评估。我们在默认阈值和同等筛查工作量下比较模型，进行重新校准后比较，在更丰富的特征集上比较，并在经济情景中与联系所有患者或不联系任何患者进行比较。结果：最佳模型为调优的逻辑回归，达到ROC曲线下面积（AUC）0.614（95%置信区间0.542-0.685）。两个自动化框架在乐观的内部验证后区分能力更差（AUC 0.416-0.519）。默认阈值下的敏感性范围为0%至41%，反映的是类别不平衡校正而非排序能力；当每个模型标记相同的28.4%患者时，传统和集成模型在46例再入院中检出11至20例。重新校准后，没有模型在预测基础率方面有所改善。分娩和出院信息将AUC提高至0.611-0.631，学习曲线平坦。按美国各州首次生育进行事后重新加权后，AUC范围为0.531至0.667，在多样性最低的州最低。对于低成本外展，联系所有人是最优策略；在接近盈亏平衡成本时，没有模型的收益超过其运行成本。结论：仅凭社会人口学数据无法支持有用的产后再入院工具，无论采用何种算法。在类别不平衡下，默认阈值比较会产生误导。适度模型的价值取决于人群和干预措施，应由决策经济分析而非仅靠区分能力来评估。未来工作应优先考虑更丰富的围产期和产后数据。

papers.title: Cross-ancestry proteome-wide Mendelian randomization of plasma proteins and breast cancer susceptibility
papers.translated_title: 跨祖先血浆蛋白质组孟德尔随机化与乳腺癌易感性研究
papers.author: Wu, X.
papers.summary: Background: The plasma proteome may help connect inherited breast cancer susceptibility to biologically interpretable and potentially actionable pathways, but proteome-wide evidence across ancestries remains limited. Methods: We conducted proteome-wide Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses of breast cancer risk using cis-protein quantitative trait loci for 1,962 distinct plasma proteins from 34,557 European-ancestry participants in the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project. Breast cancer genome-wide association studies included 156,901 cases and 204,634 controls of European, East Asian, and African ancestries. Ancestry-specific MR estimates were combined by fixed-effects meta-analysis. Candidate proteins were further evaluated through subtype-specific and reverse-direction MR analyses, statistical colocalization, replication in independent European and East Asian proteomic datasets, and analyses of associations between protein polygenic scores and breast cancer status in All of Us. Results: Twelve proteins achieved Bonferroni significance in the cross-ancestry meta-analysis (P < 0.05/1,971 tests), including eight previously reported proteins and four newly prioritized by MR. DNPH1 showed cross-ancestry heterogeneity, while CASP8, RALB, and USP28 showed cross-subtype heterogeneity after accounting for shared controls (all P < 0.05/12). Complementary support varied: six candidates showed strong colocalization (PPH4 [≥] 0.80); four replicated with a consistent direction and nominal significance in deCODE, two in the Japan COVID-19 Task Force, and four in All of Us (all P < 0.05). The strongest cumulative support was observed for LRRC25, PARK7, and LRRC37A2. Conclusions: These findings prioritize circulating protein candidates for mechanistic, prevention-oriented, and translational follow-up in breast cancer, while underscoring the need for larger ancestrally diverse proteomic resources to support equitable target and biomarker discovery.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：血浆蛋白质组可能有助于将遗传性乳腺癌易感性连接到具有生物学可解释性且可能具有可操作性的通路上，但跨 ancestry 的全蛋白质组证据仍然有限。方法：我们利用英国生物银行制药蛋白质组计划中34,557名欧洲 ancestry 参与者的1,962种不同血浆蛋白的顺式蛋白定量性状位点，对乳腺癌风险进行了全蛋白质组孟德尔随机化（MR）分析。乳腺癌全基因组关联研究包括156,901例病例和204,634例对照，涵盖欧洲、东亚和非洲 ancestry。ancestry 特异性 MR 估计值通过固定效应荟萃分析合并。候选蛋白进一步通过亚型特异性和反向 MR 分析、统计共定位、在独立欧洲和东亚蛋白质组数据集中的重复验证，以及在 All of Us 中分析蛋白多基因评分与乳腺癌状态之间的关联进行评估。结果：在跨 ancestry 荟萃分析中，有12种蛋白达到 Bonferroni 显著性（P < 0.05/1,971次检验），包括8种既往报道的蛋白和4种由 MR 新优先排序的蛋白。DNPH1显示跨 ancestry 异质性，而 CASP8、RALB 和 USP28在考虑共享对照后显示跨亚型异质性（均 P < 0.05/12）。补充支持程度不一：6个候选蛋白显示强共定位（PPH4 [≥] 0.80）；4个在 deCODE 中以一致方向和非显著名义显著性重复，2个在日本 COVID-19 工作组中重复，4个在 All of Us 中重复（均 P < 0.05）。LRRC25、PARK7 和 LRRC37A2观察到最强的累积支持。结论：这些发现优先确定了循环蛋白候选物，可用于乳腺癌的机制性、预防导向和转化后续研究，同时强调需要更大规模的 ancestry 多样化蛋白质组资源，以支持公平的靶点和生物标志物发现。

papers.title: Multi-BOUNTI: Multi-lobe Brain vOlUmetry and segmeNtation for feTal and neonatal MRI
papers.translated_title: Multi-BOUNTI：用于胎儿和新生儿MRI的多脑叶脑体积测量与分割
papers.author: Uus, A.
papers.summary: Regional volumetric assessment of perinatal brain development is currently limited by the lack of consistent high quality multi-regional fast segmentation methods applicable to both fetal and neonatal MRI. We present Multi-BOUNTI, a deep learning pipeline for automated multi-lobe segmentation of fetal and neonatal T2w brain MRI. The method is based on a dedicated 43-label parcellation protocol and a 3D Attention U-Net trained on brain MRI datasets of subjects spanning 21-44 weeks gestational/postmenstrual age. The pipeline integrates preprocessing, segmentation and volumetric analysis, and was evaluated on independent datasets, demonstrating fast (<10 min/case) and accurate performance with high agreement to manually refined labels. We demonstrate the application of the framework with 267 fetal and 593 neonatal MRI datasets from the developing Human Connectome Project without reported clinically significant brain anomalies to derive normative volumetric growth models across 21-44 weeks GA/PMA. These models were used to characterise developmental trajectories, assess differences between fetal and preterm neonatal cohorts, and analyse longitudinal changes. The resulting normative models were integrated into an automated reporting framework enabling subject-specific volumetric assessment via centiles and z-scores. Multi-BOUNTI provides a unified and scalable approach for perinatal brain segmentation and volumetry, supporting large-scale studies and facilitating future clinical translation. The full pipeline is publicly available at https://github.com/SVRTK/perinatal-brain-mri-analysis.

papers.title: Peak Agricultural Pesticide Spray Periods are related to Real-World Cognition Using an Ecological Momentary Assessment Burst Design over Two Years
papers.translated_title: 农业农药喷洒高峰期与真实世界认知相关：基于两年生态瞬时评估爆发设计的研究
papers.author: Chronister, B. N. C.
papers.summary: Objective: Emerging evidence suggests that exposure to organophosphate, neonicotinoid, and other pesticides may transiently impair cognition; however, traditional "snapshot" laboratory-based cognitive assessments fail to capture fluctuations in cognitive performance. This study used ecological momentary cognitive testing (EMCT) to evaluate whether real-world cognitive performance differs between peak and low floricultural pesticide spray seasons, thereby evaluating the potential cyclical effects of agricultural production and related pesticide exposures. Material and Methods: From 2022 to 2024, 15,063 EMCT assessments were completed by 494 participants (ages 17 to 25; 50% female) enrolled in the ESPINA cohort study in Ecuador. Participants completed nine 10-day burst assessments every 2 to 3 months during high and low pesticide spray seasons. EMCTs (NeuroUx) assessed processing speed, executive function, and visual working memory. Mixed-effects models examined associations of peak versus off-peak pesticide spray seasons, floricultural work or occupation (vs not) with EMCT performance, adjusting for socio-economic and other variables, and including participant- and burst-level random intercepts. Results: Peak pesticide spray season, compared to off-peak, was associated with higher T-scores on processing speed tests, including Matching Pair (B= 0.62) and Odd One Out (B= 0.88), but showed no significant association with other tests or the overall cognitive composite. Conversely, direct floricultural employment was significantly associated with lower cognitive performance overall (B= -0.59), with the largest differences observed in Memory Matrix (B= -0.78) and Matching Pair (B= -0.70). Conclusion: Peak pesticide spray seasons were associated with modestly higher processing speed scores, consistent with prior findings in this population suggestive of enhanced cognitive performance associated with neonicotinoid and sulfoximine exposures. In contrast, floricultural employment was associated with significantly lower memory and overall cognitive performance. These results suggest that occupational and seasonal pesticide exposure may have distinct associations with cognitive functioning, highlighting the importance of repeated cognitive testing for characterizing potentially transient effects.
papers.translated_summary: 目标：新出现的证据表明，接触有机磷、新烟碱类及其他农药可能暂时损害认知功能；然而，传统的基于实验室的“快照式”认知评估无法捕捉认知表现的波动。本研究采用生态瞬时认知测试（EMCT）评估真实世界中的认知表现是否在花卉种植农药喷洒高峰期与低峰期之间存在差异，从而评估农业生产及相关农药暴露的潜在周期性效应。材料与方法：2022年至2024年，厄瓜多尔ESPINA队列研究中纳入的494名参与者（年龄17至25岁；50%为女性）完成了15,063次EMCT评估。参与者在农药喷洒高峰期和低峰期每2至3个月完成九次为期10天的 burst 评估。EMCT（NeuroUx）评估加工速度、执行功能和视觉工作记忆。混合效应模型检验农药喷洒高峰期与非高峰期、花卉种植工作或职业（与非）与EMCT表现之间的关联，并调整社会经济及其他变量，同时纳入参与者和 burst 水平的随机截距。结果：与低峰期相比，农药喷洒高峰期与加工速度测试中更高的T分数相关，包括配对匹配（B=0.62）和找出不同项（B=0.88），但与其他测试或整体认知综合评分无显著关联。相反，直接从事花卉种植职业与整体认知表现显著较低相关（B=-0.59），其中记忆矩阵（B=-0.78）和配对匹配（B=-0.70）的差异最大。结论：农药喷洒高峰期与加工速度分数略高相关，这与该人群先前的研究结果一致，提示新烟碱类和磺酰亚胺类暴露与认知表现增强相关。相比之下，花卉种植就业与记忆和整体认知表现显著较低相关。这些结果表明，职业性和季节性农药暴露可能与认知功能存在不同的关联，凸显了重复认知测试对于表征潜在暂时性效应的重要性。
